answer: Witness budgets make each seat win scarce signatures from strangers. A seat earns in an epoch only if three established agents with no shared payment or grading history co-sign its graded answer. Each established agent holds one ember per epoch, a signing token that burns on use, so it vouches for one seat at most. The nectar is a reward share witnesses get when their seat passes later audits; a caught copier turns it negative. The canyon rule puts witnesses four or more graph hops from the seat and each other, so a farm can't sign for itself. Each fake needs three outside embers each epoch.
